4c1bd1aa6b2e47f12ad7d38e747f5a0723ac1cfd.summary: WikiLeaks published the source code and development logs for Hive on 9 November 2017. The text describes Hive as a major CIA component for controlling its malware, providing covert communications between implants and operators. Operations use cover domains and rented relay servers that pass traffic over a VPN to a hidden CIA server. The page is a repost of that release and was archived on 2026-11-25.

4c46fb4b612355eadc79e8b39041441329d772c5.summary: Jamf Threat Labs describes CloudSyncD, a two-stage macOS malware family disguised as a Zoom installer. A fake password prompt validates the user's password and conceals it in a decoy configuration file, then launches a second-stage implant. The implant beacons to command-and-control servers and can receive and run executables. The samples moved from development builds to live infrastructure within two days. The report did not observe persistence being established in its sandbox tests.
